content.comment_body: Hi, this is my first post here and I wanted to say hello. I am having trouble getting the function keys of my HMI device [product_name] to work with [product_name] over Ethernet. I can successfully view the counter on the HMI, but when I try to use a function key (like F1), nothing happens. In [product_name], I connected the F1 function key to reset the counter input, but it does not respond. Communication between the devices is established, and I am able to modify the counter value using the cursor and delete keys on the HMI screen, but I need to trigger actions via the function keys. Thanks. Edit: I have made some progress. I created a button on the screen and set up a hotkey using a function key, which works. Is there a way to use the function key directly? Is it possible to disable changing the counter value with the cursor and escape keys?

Hello, the function keys F1 to F4 of the [product_name] TD are not the same as the function keys on an HMI device like [product_name]. They only correspond to the TD function keys, not the HMI device keys. I hope this clarifies things.

This explanation helps somewhat. If I use a network input in [product_name] and create a Boolean tag linked to it in [product_name], then bind it to a function key on the HMI with an on-press action to invert the bit, it does not work. However, if I create a button on the screen with the same action and configure a hotkey linked to the function key (F1), it works as expected.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing challenges making the function keys of an HMI work directly with controller features using [product_name] and related tools over Ethernet. Although standard monitoring and communication are functioning, direct assignment of function keys for specific actions on the controller is ineffective. The user found that using on-screen buttons with hotkeys as a workaround does work, but function keys alone do not trigger the intended actions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the HMI device’s function keys to control the controller features directly, similar to how [product_name] TD function keys work, and wishes to limit value changes to only certain keys for improved control.
